label: Financial Assistance
assignment: Discover realistic financial-assistance resources for people in {service_area} facing urgent bills or income shortfalls. Follow coordinating agencies to the specific rent, deposit, utility, emergency-cash, benefit, tax, debt, and financial-counseling programs people can access. Verify funding status, covered expense, eligibility, limits, documentation, payment method, and application sequence.
include: Emergency rent, deposit, mortgage, utility, transportation, burial, and other essential-expense help
Public cash benefits, disability-related income, unemployment, and benefit navigation
Tax preparation, refundable-credit help, debt and credit counseling, and safe banking support
Flexible funds and population-specific assistance for veterans, survivors, families, immigrants, or people in crisis
The current funding window, priority rules, documentation, and direct-vendor payment process
exclude: Payday loans, title loans, high-cost credit, debt settlement, or products likely to worsen hardship
Fundraising pages or informal gifts without an accountable program and eligibility process
Programs whose funds are closed, exhausted, or restricted elsewhere unless clearly marked as a future lead
